actual.descripcion: First Round | The PGA Tour's top 30 players begin the TOUR Championship at East Lake Golf Club in Atlanta. The FedExCup finale features 72 holes of stroke play, with all competitors starting at even par and the lowest score after four rounds wins the Championship.

lista.descripcion: Husqvarna British Masters, First Round | The opening round of the 2026 Husqvarna British Masters begins at the Belfry Hotel & Resort, Sutton Coldfield, England. The tournament is hosted by European golf legend Sir Nick Faldo. Players are competing for a total prize fund of $3.5 million.

lista.descripcion: Husqvarna British Masters, Second Round | The second round of the Husqvarna British Masters continues at the Belfry Hotel & Resort in Sutton Coldfield.
